// AdasObjects: CAN ID 0x600 (standard, CAN FD), 24 bytes, sender ECM, cycle time 50 ms
// ADAS object list broadcast (CAN FD, 24-byte payload).
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[23] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// ObjCount: start bit 0, 4 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 15
ObjCount_raw = data[0] & 0x0F
ObjCount = ObjCount_raw

// Obj1Dist: start bit 8, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.01, offset 0, range 0 .. 655.35 m
Obj1Dist_raw = data[1] | (data[2] << 8)
Obj1Dist = Obj1Dist_raw * 0.01

// Obj1Speed: start bit 24, 16 bits, Intel, signed, factor 0.01, offset 0, range -327.68 .. 327.67 m/s
Obj1Speed_raw = data[3] | (data[4] << 8)
if Obj1Speed_raw >= 32768: Obj1Speed_raw = Obj1Speed_raw - 65536
Obj1Speed = Obj1Speed_raw * 0.01

// Obj1Angle: start bit 40, 16 bits, Intel, signed, factor 0.1, offset 0, range -3276.8 .. 3276.7 deg
Obj1Angle_raw = data[5] | (data[6] << 8)
if Obj1Angle_raw >= 32768: Obj1Angle_raw = Obj1Angle_raw - 65536
Obj1Angle = Obj1Angle_raw * 0.1

// Obj2Dist: start bit 56, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.01, offset 0, range 0 .. 655.35 m
Obj2Dist_raw = data[7] | (data[8] << 8)
Obj2Dist = Obj2Dist_raw * 0.01

// Obj2Speed: start bit 72, 16 bits, Intel, signed, factor 0.01, offset 0, range -327.68 .. 327.67 m/s
Obj2Speed_raw = data[9] | (data[10] << 8)
if Obj2Speed_raw >= 32768: Obj2Speed_raw = Obj2Speed_raw - 65536
Obj2Speed = Obj2Speed_raw * 0.01
